gold_note: Slanted cladogram on a spine (classed slanted): under the out-of-scope ruling for slanted cladograms on a spine (otero2010a_fig15), flagged. The Huayangosaurus line and the Scelidosaurus+Emausaurus line converge into one wedge that meets the spine where the root stem leaves it; read as a root polytomy of three. Node N is a polytomy of six (the Tarchia+Saichania pair, four genera and the Euoplocephalus line). Node letters A-P (white dots) are not clade names and are not encoded. 24 tips, 2 polytomies (3, 6 children). Sample 10 case (census 3, seed 20261274). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
